Mine guard

Biography

The mine guard is a witness in the investigation of Brissen’s murder. He allowed Yam-Akara into the mines despite an expired permit. His account and the stamped pass establish where the magician had been, making this otherwise minor soldier important to clearing a suspect. [1]
